user_question: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Create Centre County boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Create a single county boundary from the supplied county subdivision polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Dissolve the county subdivision polygons into one Centre County boundary.

workflow_steps.title: Clip tracts to Centre County
workflow_steps.purpose: Restrict the tract polygons to the dissolved Centre County boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip the tract polygon layer to the dissolved Centre County boundary.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals by tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate the number of hospitals located within each Centre County tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count the hospital point features from input_1 within each polygon in centre_county_tracts and store the result in a field named hospital_count.

workflow_steps.title: Generate hospital count choropleth
workflow_steps.purpose: Create the requested choropleth map showing hospital counts across Centre County.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an interactive HTML choropleth map from hospital_count_tracts using the hospital_count field as the mapped attribute.
